title: POST /v1/me/agents request
description: Body of POST /v1/me/agents (11-agent-access.md section 4): the new form (gen, cert, user_ct, batches, cred_wraps; ADR-082 section 2) or the old form with bundle_ct (only from the agent of an account without a passkey; a browser gets 409 client_outdated).

bundle_ct.description: the old form (ADR-056): the user's identity sealed to the agent

handover_ct.description: the handover sealed to the agent (11-agent-access.md section 3): required for a remote pairing (400 handover_required), refused for a loopback pairing (400 handover_unexpected)

gen.description: the generation the certificate names: the gen of GET /v1/agent-pairings/{id} signed by the user (409 agent_gen_mismatch otherwise)

cert.description: the user's delegation certificate (Ed25519 signature, ADR-082 section 9.1)

user_ct.description: the user's public keys and the certificate sealed to the agent under the handover secret (ADR-082 section 2)

items.description: one append batch per organization in which the user is an active member: the body of POST /v1/orgs/{org}/log without events, entries by the user (ADR-082 section 2)

cred_wraps.description: the user's CK epochs wrapped to the agent (scope cred, scope_id the user, recipient the agent)
